description: This file contains utility functions and classes related to FakeTensor handling, tensor aliasing checks, and a custom TorchDispatchMode for cross-referencing fake and real tensors within PyTorch's _subclasses module.

classes.name: CrossRefFakeMode
classes.description: A custom TorchDispatchMode that compares outputs of fake tensors and real tensors, checking for aliasing, shape, and metadata consistency.

methods.name: outputs_alias_inputs
methods.description: Checks if outputs alias the inputs based on storage data.

methods.name: outputs_are_inputs
methods.description: Checks if outputs are the same objects as inputs based on their IDs.

methods.name: output_alias_each_other
methods.description: Checks if outputs alias each other based on shared storage.

methods.name: is_sdpa_error
methods.description: Determines if an exception is related to specific SDPA (Sparse Dense Parallel Algorithm) errors for certain aten functions.

methods.name: try_convert_fake_to_real
methods.description: Attempts to convert FakeTensors in a list to real tensors with matching storage, using the FakeTensorMode meta information.

methods.name: _check_fake_real_tensors
methods.description: Validates that a FakeTensor and a real tensor have matching metadata, including requires_grad, storage offset, size, and stride.
